title: What Bio-Hydrogen Generators Is

description: Bio-hydrogen generators make hydrogen with living things: engineered microbes and algae splitting water or fermenting waste into H2 — hydrogen from sunlight and sewage, at ambient temperature and pressure. Where it is used: clean hydrogen, waste treatment, remote power, biofuels..
